name: Simple Predicate Pushdown
sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT o_orderkey, o_custkey, o_orderstatus FROM orders) AS sub WHERE o_orderstatus = 'O';
expected_optimization: The predicate 'o_orderstatus = \'O\'' should be pushed down into the subquery.

name: Predicate Pushdown on Lineitem
sql: SELECT l_orderkey FROM (SELECT l_orderkey, l_extendedprice, l_discount FROM lineitem) AS sub WHERE l_discount > 0.05 AND l_extendedprice < 1000;
expected_optimization: Push both 'l_discount > 0.05' and 'l_extendedprice < 1000' down into the subquery to filter rows earlier.

name: Projection Pruning on Customer
sql: SELECT c_custkey, c_name FROM (SELECT c_custkey, c_name, c_address, c_phone, c_acctbal FROM customer) AS sub;
expected_optimization: Remove c_address, c_phone, and c_acctbal from the inner subquery since they are not used in the outer SELECT.

name: Projection Pruning on Part
sql: SELECT p_partkey FROM (SELECT * FROM part) AS sub;
expected_optimization: Warn about SELECT * or safely prune everything except p_partkey in the inner query.

name: Subquery Unnesting IN Clause
sql: SELECT * FROM customer WHERE c_custkey IN (SELECT o_custkey FROM orders);
expected_optimization: Unnest the IN subquery to a JOIN: SELECT customer.* FROM customer JOIN orders ON customer.c_custkey = orders.o_custkey;

name: Subquery Unnesting on Supplier
sql: SELECT * FROM supplier WHERE s_nationkey IN (SELECT n_nationkey FROM nation);
expected_optimization: Unnest the IN subquery to a JOIN between supplier and nation on nationkey.

name: Predicate Pushdown + Projection Pruning
sql: SELECT o_orderdate FROM (SELECT o_orderkey, o_custkey, o_orderstatus, o_orderdate FROM orders) AS sub WHERE o_orderstatus = 'F';
expected_optimization: Push down 'o_orderstatus = \'F\'' and prune o_orderkey and o_custkey from the inner query.

name: Subquery Unnesting + Predicate Pushdown
sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM nation) AS n WHERE n_regionkey IN (SELECT r_regionkey FROM region WHERE r_name = 'ASIA');
expected_optimization: Push down 'r_name = \'ASIA\'' and unnest the IN clause into a JOIN between nation and region.

name: Projection Pruning + Subquery Unnesting
sql: SELECT p_name FROM (SELECT p_partkey, p_name, p_mfgr FROM part) AS p WHERE p_partkey IN (SELECT l_partkey FROM lineitem);
expected_optimization: Prune p_mfgr from the inner query and unnest the IN clause to a JOIN.

name: Complex TPC-H Query Simulation
sql: SELECT c_name FROM (SELECT c_custkey, c_name, c_nationkey FROM customer) AS c WHERE c_custkey IN (SELECT o_custkey FROM orders WHERE o_orderdate >= '1995-01-01');
expected_optimization: Push down date filter, prune c_nationkey, and rewrite IN clause to JOIN.
